scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @gense/server & npm run dev -w @gense/web
scripts.sandbox:build: docker build --network host --target slim -t gense-sandbox:slim sandbox && docker build --network host --target full -t gense-sandbox:full sandbox
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck -w @gense/web && OPENUI_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 npm run genui:check -w @gense/web && npm test
